questions.q: Let $A$ be the matrix with rows $\langle1,3\rangle$ and $\langle-2,4\rangle$, and $B$ be the matrix with rows $\langle2,-1\rangle$ and $\langle0,5\rangle$. Find $A+B$ and $2A$.
questions.answer: $A+B$ has rows $\langle3,2\rangle$ and $\langle-2,9\rangle$. $2A$ has rows $\langle2,6\rangle$ and $\langle-4,8\rangle$.

questions.q: Using $A$ (rows $\langle1,3\rangle$, $\langle-2,4\rangle$) and $B$ (rows $\langle2,-1\rangle$, $\langle0,5\rangle$) from above, find $AB$.
questions.answer: $AB$ has rows $\langle2,14\rangle$ and $\langle-4,22\rangle$: e.g. row $1$, column $1$ is $(1)(2)+(3)(0)=2$.

questions.q: Let $A$ have rows $\langle1,3\rangle$ and $\langle-2,4\rangle$, and let $\mathbf{v}=\langle3,-1\rangle$. Find $A\mathbf{v}$.
Find $\det A$ for the matrix $A$ with rows $\langle1,3\rangle$ and $\langle-2,4\rangle$, and state whether $A$ is invertible.
Find $A^{-1}$ for the matrix $A$ with rows $\langle1,3\rangle$ and $\langle-2,4\rangle$.
questions.answer: $A^{-1}=\dfrac{1}{10}\times$ the matrix with rows $\langle4,-3\rangle$ and $\langle2,1\rangle$, i.e., $A^{-1}$ has rows $\langle0.4,-0.3\rangle$ and $\langle0.2,0.1\rangle$.

questions.answer: $\det A=(-6)(-8)-(5)(7)=48-35=13$, so $A$ is invertible since $\det A\neq0$.

questions.q: Find $\det A$ for the matrix $A$ with rows $\langle-5,-3\rangle$ and $\langle6,4\rangle$.
questions.answer: $\det A=(-5)(4)-(-3)(6)=-20-(-18)=-2$, so $A$ is invertible since $\det A\neq0$.

questions.q: Find $\det A$ for the matrix $A$ with rows $\langle7,4\rangle$ and $\langle3,5\rangle$.
questions.answer: $\det A=(7)(5)-(4)(3)=35-12=23$, so $A$ is invertible since $\det A\neq0$.

questions.q: Find $\det A$ for the matrix $A$ with rows $\langle1,8\rangle$ and $\langle-1,6\rangle$.
questions.answer: $\det A=(1)(6)-(8)(-1)=6-(-8)=14$, so $A$ is invertible since $\det A\neq0$.

questions.q: Find $\det A$ for the matrix $A$ with rows $\langle-3,-3\rangle$ and $\langle-3,5\rangle$.
questions.answer: $\det A=(-3)(5)-(-3)(-3)=-15-9=-24$, so $A$ is invertible since $\det A\neq0$.
